scenarios.title: Release notes, one column
scenarios.description: Wrapping prose paragraphs rewritten between two drafts, shown as a unified diff.

data.text:
This release improves delivery tracking for regional carriers.

Shipments are now grouped by city. Late shipments include the reason reported by the carrier.

The legacy status endpoint is still available but will be removed in a future release.

No configuration changes are required.

If you call the legacy status endpoint, plan to migrate to the report command.

This release improves delivery tracking for regional and national carriers.

Shipments are now grouped by city. Late shipments include the reason reported by the carrier, and the time it was reported.

A new --late-only option shows only shipments that need attention.

The legacy status endpoint has been removed. Use `parcel report` instead.

Reports in CSV format are available with --format csv.
